property_summary: After a successful initialize call, the feeRate of the contract must equal the _feeRate parameter passed to initialize (which the reference enforces by allowing any _feeRate <= 5000, but the mutant rejects all positive _feeRate values and sets feeRate to 0 instead).
change_summary: Change the require condition to _feeRate > 0 so only strictly positive feeRates revert
